description: This Java source file defines the DataInitializer class, which is a Spring Boot component responsible for seeding initial data such as customers, accounts, account-customer relationships, and transactions on application startup when the 'seed' profile is active. It ensures idempotent creation of data, avoiding duplicates by checking existing entries before inserting. The class implements CommandLineRunner and uses various repositories to perform database operations.

classes.name: DataInitializer
classes.description: A Spring Component that seeds initial customer, account, account-customer link, and transaction data during application startup when the 'seed' profile is active. It ensures data is created if not already present, to set up sample data for the application.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method executed on application startup, performing the seeding process by creating customers, accounts, linking them, and adding initial deposits if needed.

methods.name: ensureCustomer
methods.description: Checks for an existing customer with given details; if not found, creates and saves a new customer record.

methods.name: ensureAccount
methods.description: Checks for an existing account with the given account number; if not found, creates and saves a new account with the specified details.

methods.name: ensureXref
methods.description: Creates an association between a customer and account with a specified role if it does not already exist.

methods.name: ensureInitialDeposit
methods.description: Checks if the account already has transactions; if not, adds an initial deposit transaction and updates the account balance accordingly.
